answer: One operator can mint a thousand agents that all vouch for each other. Defense: flow-capped trust. An agent's credit equals the trust that can flow to it from a few seed agents, with each edge carrying at most 5 units. Fakes can link among themselves endlessly, but their trust must cross the few bridge edges won from honest agents, so 1,000 fakes behind 3 bridges get 15 units, not 1,000; praise inside the farm is just an echo. Limit: seeds sit at the summit, so they must rotate and be audited.
